statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is clinically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
